slides.texte_overlay:
How to build quiet confidence
that people feel instantly
Speak a little slower than feels natural. Rushing sounds nervous. A calm pace tells people you're comfortable and that what you say is worth waiting for.
Stop explaining yourself so much. Give your reason once and stop. Confident men don't need everyone to agree before they make a decision.
Keep promises to yourself. Wake up when you said you would, train when you planned to. Confidence is built on proof that you can trust yourself.
Be comfortable with silence. You don't need to fill every pause. A relaxed silence shows people you're at ease, and they relax around you too.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Knowing a little about many things makes you calm in any conversation.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Knowing a little about many things makes you calm in any conversation.

slides.texte_overlay: Compliment people without wanting anything back. Only secure men can celebrate others freely. People notice it and remember how you made them feel.
Admit when you don't know something. "I'm not sure, tell me more." Pretending is a sign of insecurity. Curiosity is a sign of real confidence.
